reviewsModeration.title: Review moderation
reviewsModeration.subtitle: Approve, remove, or restore student company reviews. A genuinely negative opinion is not a removal ground.
reviewsModeration.permissionBody: You do not have permission to moderate reviews.
reviewsModeration.removePolicyNote: Only remove for a policy violation (PII, harassment, spam, false claim). A negative-but-genuine opinion must stay.
reviewsModeration.notePlaceholder: Optional internal note (not shown to the author)
reviewsModeration.insightFlaggedUrgent: Flagged reviews need attention — these may involve policy violations
reviewsModeration.insightPendingReviews: Multiple reviews pending — publish or moderate to keep the platform fresh
reviewsModeration.insightQueueClear: Moderation queue is clear — no pending or flagged reviews
reviewsModeration.insightMixedQueue: Both pending and flagged reviews present — address flagged ones first
